development_backbone.rights_scope: Retraction Watch database metadata fields only; linked articles, abstracts, notices, attachments, supplements and blog posts are separate content classes.

rights_valid_metadata_relation_pool.boundary: Metadata relation and endpoint-rights feasibility only; none is yet an eligible R7A case dossier or scientific-action gold item.

provider_structured_action_feasibility.boundary: Provider metadata conformance is not independent semantic gold, owner authority or a one-to-one R7 action bridge.

family_collapse_keys_in_precedence_order: canonical study, dataset, project or companion-paper family

development_and_replication_separation.development: Pinned 2026-08-21 Retraction Watch CC0 connected families; public-label development authority only.
development_and_replication_separation.protected_replication: Rights-cleared Europe PMC/PMC original-notice families or a prospectively frozen later source wave acquired by an owner-separated custodian.
development_and_replication_separation.hard_disjointness: No original DOI/PMID, notice DOI/PMID, update chain, study, dataset, project, author family or derivative record family may cross waves.
development_and_replication_separation.provider_warning: A temporal wave from the same curator is not owner-disjoint cross-provider replication and must be reported separately.

visible: rights-cleared noisy scientific symptom and evidence objects
anti_leak_required: remove titles, filenames, paths, URL slugs, headings, publication types, relation types and explicit action tokens
blind filename, phrase, provider, ordering and publication-type responders remain at the frozen null
no rule or promoted action cell has fewer than 20 independent update families
leave-one-family and leave-one-provider shortcut audits pass before candidate scoring
if redaction destroys the scientific discriminator, exclude the family rather than reconstructing a label

typed_action_gold.adjudication: Two owner-separated blinded adjudicators apply the completed V9 algebra; unresolved disagreement after a sealed third review is UNRESOLVED.

matched_arms.relation_ablated_donor: Receives diagnosis, repair, rollback, preservation and budget information but not the responsibility-to-authority coupling.
matched_arms.information_equivalent_donor: Receives identical responsibility and legal-authority semantics and is required to tie.

registered_scale_preserved.large_effect_power_boundary: The inherited design has projected max-T joint power 0.920216 at delta 0.20 and discordance 0.40, but only 0.06778 at delta 0.15 and n=384; no positive result is promised.

pre_execution_gates: V9 owner algebra complete and independently CONFORMANT
outcome-blind connected-family census with exact exclusions
rights complete for every candidate-visible byte
all required cells meet independent-family minima without top-up
typed gold, candidate views and all hostile leakage checks complete
candidate, donor-complete, information-equivalent and external adapters bound
changed semantic host and owner-separated source, case, gold, scoring and verification custody bound
positive_condition: The licensing relation improves protected source-cluster-weighted legal-action utility over every target-sufficient matched donor without excess broad transition, preserves the required information-equivalent tie and replicates on the protected wave and worst domains.
negative_condition: A target-sufficient donor ties or wins, mixed fibres are negligible, leakage persists, redaction removes the discriminator, or the relation adds no value or increases harm.
cannot_check_condition: Any V9, rights, relation, gold, family-count, anti-leak, adapter, host, scorer or custody gate remains unbound.
